supervisor.value: Department cannot admit without a formal advisor commitment; contact a prospective advisor (via the associate head) before applying, and name your preferred supervisor in the application
supervisor.quote: The Department of Physics and Astronomy cannot admit graduate students without the formal commitment of an advisor. | Direct application to the Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies without prior contact with a potential advisor may not succeed and will result in the loss of the application fee

also.quote: The name of your preferred supervisor is required at time of application.

funding.value: All students admitted to research-based graduate programs are guaranteed a department-set minimum stipend; 2026-27 PhD stipends CAD 27,000 (grant funded) to 40,000 (NSERC), excluding up to CAD 3,000 TA income
funding.quote: All students who are accepted into a research-based graduate program are guaranteed a basic minimum stipend, which is set by the department on an annual basis. | Grant funded | $ 27,000

entry_route.value: PhD normally requires a master's; exceptional honours-bachelor's applicants may be considered on special department recommendation; master's students can transfer
entry_route.quote: A master's degree or equivalent from a recognized university with a cumulative GPA of 3.0 in the last two years of full-time university study

also.quote: With special recommendation of the department, exceptional applicants with an honours bachelor’s degree may be considered for entry to PhD study.

notes: Program listed as Physics and Astronomy (PhD); Medical and Health Physics PhD is a stream. Applying without prior advisor contact can forfeit the fee. All scholarships except NSERC are open to international students.
